title: answers stream upstream_event record (v1)
description: One preserved upstream event of a streamed answers run: a well-formed tag outside the documented set, or a documented tag whose semantics no live evidence has pinned yet, kept verbatim with its name and its raw payload text — bounded by the stream decode ceilings. An unknown tag whose server-sent-event block carried an id, retry, or event name preserves them as the optional sse_id, sse_retry_ms, and event_name members.

raw.$comment: The tag's raw payload text exactly as the stream carried it.

sse_id.$comment: The most recent id field of the SSE block that carried the tag, present exactly when the block offered one.

sse_retry_ms.$comment: The retry milliseconds current at the block's dispatch, present exactly when a valid retry was seen.

event_name.$comment: The event field's value of the SSE block that carried the tag, present exactly when the block named its event.
